newsitem.title: USA: Quake hits islands in western Pacific.
newsitem.headline: Quake hits islands in western Pacific.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 7.9 on the open-ended Richter scale hit a largely unpopulated area in the western Pacific on Monday, the Earthquake Information Centre said.

The epicentre of the quake was estimated to be in the Santa Cruz Islands in the Pacific, Waverly Person, director of the U.S. Geological Service's Earthquake Information Centre, said. "It's not a heavily populated area," he said.
A tsunami warning was issued for the islands near the epicentre after the quake but was later cancelled, he said. The quake struck at 1202 GMT, Person said.
The Santa Cruz Islands lie in the South Pacific southeast of the Solomon Islands.
